scope: Offline model-presentation measurement of existing local-retrieval snapshot; no semantic, retrieval-relevance or live-browser acceptance claim
retained_fields: Every other canonical legal-row field, including exact text, ID, title, locator, speaker/status, case or Act identity, source position, work membership, ordered context neighbours and full distinct coverage/gaps
remaining_work: Reduce irrelevant or duplicated retrieval enquiries at their owning stage without dropping requested work; legitimately large relevant source sets still need explicit scoped processing. No truncation, aliases or document-sharing contract applied.

offline_tests.command: python -m pytest tests/test_core_answer_sources.py tests/test_core_response_writer.py tests/test_core_response_review.py tests/test_core_turn.py tests/test_core_served.py -q
